newsHighlights.title: APEC outcomes aim to boost trade and connectivity
newsHighlights.summary: APEC economic leaders agreed on measures to facilitate cross-border trade, strengthen regional connectivity and harness emerging technologies to promote employment.
newsHighlights.translation: 亚太经合组织经济领导人就便利跨境贸易、加强区域互联互通、利用新兴技术促进就业等达成一致。

newsHighlights.title: International network launched to streamline silk standards
newsHighlights.summary: An international network has been launched to streamline silk standards, making quality and safety rules more consistent across borders.
newsHighlights.translation: 一个旨在精简丝绸标准的国际网络正式启动，使质量安全规则在跨境范围内更加统一。

newsHighlights.title: Xi calls for inclusive regional cooperation based on solidarity, openness and innovation
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi called for inclusive regional cooperation rooted in solidarity, openness and innovation to deliver shared benefits for people in the Asia-Pacific.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平主席呼吁以团结、开放、创新为基础推进包容性区域合作，让亚太民众共享发展红利。

newsHighlights.title: Iran's navy says oil tanker caught fire after hitting naval mine east of Strait of Hormuz
newsHighlights.summary: Iran's navy said an oil tanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine east of the Strait of Hormuz, raising safety and environmental concerns.
newsHighlights.translation: 伊朗海军称，一艘油轮在霍尔木兹海峡以东触雷起火，引发安全与环境担忧。

quote.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
quote.explanation: 爱默生把健康视为最根本的财富。今日新闻中，贸易便利化、统一的产品标准与区域合作，最终都是为了让人们获得更安全的食品、更稳定的就业与更洁净的环境——这些正是健康的基石。

pattern.pattern: call on sb. to do A and (to) do B（呼吁某人做……并做……）
pattern.example: President Xi called on China and Malaysia to deepen strategic coordination and jointly advance global governance reform.
pattern.translation: 习主席呼吁中马深化战略协作，共同推进全球治理改革。
pattern.usage: 用于提出倡议或呼吁。结构为 call on + 人/组织 + to 动词原形 + and + to 动词原形，第二个 to 常省略。可用于写作中提出建议，如：The report calls on cities to invest in public transport and to protect green spaces.

grammar.title: 并列不定式（Parallel Infinitives）表示多重目的
grammar.explanation: 当一句话要表达多个并列的目的时，可用 to + 动词1、动词2、and 动词3 的结构，只保留第一个 to，后接动词原形平行排列。这种结构让句子简洁有力，是英语新闻标题与导语中的高频句式。注意并列成分必须保持相同的语法形式和逻辑层次。
examples: APEC leaders agreed on measures to facilitate cross-border trade, strengthen regional connectivity and harness emerging technologies to promote employment.
The network was created to streamline silk standards, protect consumers and cut trade costs.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第二个音节 /ˈsɪlɪ/，开头的 fa 弱读为 /fə/，不是 /feɪ/。注意 -ci- 在这里读 /s/，-ate 结尾读 /eɪt/。整个词可拆读为 fə-SIL-i-tate，四个音节均匀清晰。
examples: New rules will facilitate cross-border travel and trade.
Standardized labels facilitate healthier choices for shoppers.

reading.title: From Trade Talks to Everyday Well-being
reading.content: When APEC leaders agreed to facilitate cross-border trade and strengthen regional connectivity, the discussion sounded far from daily life. Yet the outcomes also aim to harness emerging technologies to promote employment, and a stable job is the first step toward a healthy life. Meanwhile, an international network has been launched to streamline silk standards, so that products crossing borders meet the same safety and quality rules. Clearer standards protect consumers and reduce health risks. Regional cooperation matters for safety at sea as well: after an oil tanker caught fire east of the Strait of Hormuz, better coordination and mutual trust can prevent disasters from harming coastal communities. Inclusive regional cooperation based on solidarity, openness and innovation is not only about growth figures. It is about affordable medicine, safer food, cleaner air and more secure jobs. Diplomacy, in the end, reaches our tables, our hospitals and our lungs.
reading.translation: 当亚太经合组织领导人同意便利跨境贸易、加强区域互联互通时，这些讨论听起来似乎与日常生活相距甚远。然而，会议成果还提出利用新兴技术促进就业，而一份稳定的工作正是健康生活的第一步。与此同时，一个旨在精简丝绸标准的国际网络正式启动，使跨境商品遵循统一的安全与质量规则。更清晰的标准保护消费者、降低健康风险。区域合作对海上安全同样重要：在霍尔木兹海峡以东一艘油轮触雷起火之后，更有力的协调与互信能够防止灾难伤害沿海社区。以团结、开放、创新为基础的包容性区域合作，关乎的不只是增长数字，更是可负担的药品、更安全的食品、更洁净的空气和更稳定的工作。说到底，外交最终会抵达我们的餐桌、医院与呼吸之间。
reading.sourceNote: 基于 ChinaDaily 关于 APEC 成果、丝绸标准国际网络、包容性区域合作，以及 CGTN 关于霍尔木兹海峡油轮起火的今日新闻改写，主题聚焦健康与生活。
